package_info:
Name: gpu-compute
Version: 0.3.1
Summary: GPU-accelerated computation library with optional CUDA support
Home-page: https://github.com/example/gpu-compute
License: Apache-2.0
Requires-Python: >=3.9
Requires-Dist: nvidia-cuda-runtime-cu12; extra == "cuda"
analysis: Package with optional CUDA acceleration. Builds a pure-Python fallback on CPU and a CUDA-accelerated C extension on GPU stacks. Should be added to both CPU and CUDA variants since the build output differs across stacks.
failure_summary: Initial source build succeeded on CPU (pure-Python fallback). CUDA variant requires nvidia-cuda-runtime-cu12 for GPU-accelerated extension.
jira_context: Onboard gpu-compute 0.3.1 to the builder. Package requires CUDA for GPU kernels.
